raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the director of Mirage (1972) as Edward Dmytryk (confusing it with the 1965 American film), despite WebSurfer’s results clearly showing the 1972 film (Espejismo) was directed by Armando Robles Godoy. This incorrect disambiguation could directly lead to the wrong father being reported.
